relevance_note: Single-patient case report of FLD with an LCAT variant: "He had a missense mutation in exon 6 of the LCAT gene (p.Thr321Met)."
method_note: Read the whole paper; built the JSON with a short Python script from my own reading (no table transcription; the paper has no tables). Rows: the index patient ('patient', single case report, also previously reported in ref 10), his brother (FLD, previously reported in ref 12; features from Discussion), and two previously published FLD patients mentioned in the Discussion with an individual-level feature: ref 9 (increased corneal thickness by ultrasound pachymetry) and ref 21 (angioid streaks; attribution to ref 21 is by elimination from 'two cases ... ^12^,^21' with the ref 12 case being the brother). Left out: the Palmiero et al. (ref 14) patient, because the authors argue that patient's findings are 'not indicative of FLD' and that no LCAT gene test or LCAT activity was reported, so the diagnosis is disputed in this paper. Zygosity of p.Thr321Met is not stated (only 'a missense mutation'), so left not reported; no cDNA printed. The brother's variant is not stated, so no variant row for him. Variant attribution to ref 11 (Maeda 1995 abstract). 'No obvious signs of skin lesions or systemic disease' recorded as written; it was not used to exclude anemia, kidney or other checklist items. Normal central and peripheral corneal thickness recorded as excluded 'increased corneal thickness' (D-27). Age at last evaluation is 78 years at the ophthalmology visit; follow-up reached 20 months after surgery. Vital status not explicitly stated. No lipid, renal or haematological data are reported for any person, so those checklist items are not reported. Typo 'undergome' kept verbatim in spans. No internal contradictions found.
